notes.title: Releasing Next Friday, April 26.
notes.notes:
We'd like to inform everyone that the release date has been confirmed for Friday, April 26! The store date has been changed from TBD -> 26 Apr, 2019.

If you have owned any of our previous Winged Sakura games, and is curious on the loyalty rewards, an announcement was made to each store page.

For your convenience, the links are provided below.
